record.paper_title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems
record.original_question: Let X1 and X2 be Gushel-Mukai varieties of the same dimension. If there is an equivalence Ku(X1) ~= Ku(X2) between their Kuznetsov components, must X1 and X2 be birational?

evidence.quote: then X_1 and X_2 are birational

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A Gushel–Mukai (GM) variety is a smooth projective complex variety X of dimension n ∈ {3,4,5,6} obtained as a transverse intersection of the cone (in P^{10}) over the Grassmannian Gr(2,5) ⊂ P^9 with a linear subspace and a quadric hypersurface. The bounded derived category D^b(X) admits a semiorthogonal decomposition whose nontrivial "Kuznetsov component" Ku(X) is defined as the right orthogonal to an exceptional collection coming from O_X and (when n is even) U_X^∨, where U_X is the restriction of the tautological rank-2 subbundle on Gr(2,5); more precisely, Ku(X) is the full triangulated subcategory of D^b(X) of objects right-orthogonal to this exceptional collection, and it is a 2-Calabi–Yau category for n even and a fractional Calabi–Yau category for n odd.

Question: Let X_1 and X_2 be two Gushel–Mukai varieties of the same dimension. Suppose there exists a C-linear exact equivalence of triangulated categories Ku(X_1) ≃ Ku(X_2). Must X_1 and X_2 be birational?
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture has been established in significant cases but not in full generality. In particular, a birational categorical Torelli theorem is known for general ordinary Gushel–Mukai threefolds (Jacovskis–Lin–Liu–Zhang and related work), and results on periods of GM varieties have resolved the conjecture in further cases. The general statement across all dimensions and all GM varieties does not appear fully established in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Categorical Torelli theorems for Gushel–Mukai threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: if X and X' are general ordinary GM threefolds with Ku(X) ≃ Ku(X'), then X is birational to X'
status_evidence.claim: Birational categorical Torelli is proven for general ordinary GM threefolds.

status_evidence.title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture: equivalence of Kuznetsov components implies birationality of GM varieties
status_evidence.claim: Stated as conjecture for general GM varieties of the same dimension.
